recipes.name: Avocado and lime dip
recipes.description: A simple mashed avocado dip with lime, onion, chile and cilantro.
instructions: Mash avocado with lime juice to a chunky texture
Fold in onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeno
Season and serve promptly with tortillas or vegetables.
recipes.sides: Serve with tacos, tostadas or grilled vegetables.
recipes.substitutions: Omit chile or tomato as preferred.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; cover closely and refrigerate for no more than 1 day.
recipes.safety: Wash produce before preparation; keep chilled if not serving immediately.

recipes.name: Bread rolls dipped in guajillo salsa
recipes.description: Soft rolls filled with potato and chorizo, coated in chile sauce and griddled.
instructions: Simmer potatoes until tender and drain
cook chorizo in pan, add potatoes and mash roughly
Soak guajillo chiles in hot water until soft
blend with onion, garlic and soaking water, then strain
Split rolls and fill with potato mixture
dip outsides briefly in salsa
Griddle in a little oil, turning until warm and lightly crisp
serve with lettuce and crema.
recipes.sides: Serve hot as a substantial snack.
recipes.substitutions: Use mushrooms and smoked paprika instead of chorizo.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate filling and sauce separately up to 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook chorizo fully and keep filled rolls hot before serving.

recipes.name: Cactus paddle salad
recipes.description: Tender cactus strips tossed with tomato, onion, cilantro and fresh cheese.
instructions: Simmer nopales in lightly salted water until tender, 12 to 15 minutes
drain and rinse
Cool fully and drain well
Mix with tomato, onion, cilantro and lime
crumble cheese over top and season.
recipes.sides: Serve with tostadas or grilled meat.
recipes.substitutions: Use green beans if nopales are unavailable.
recipes.storage: Keep refrigerated and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Wash produce and keep salad chilled.

recipes.name: Cheese quesadillas
recipes.description: Corn tortillas folded around melting cheese and cooked until crisp.
ingredients: 250 g Oaxaca or mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/2 cup cooked mushrooms or squash blossoms, optional
instructions: Warm a tortilla on a dry pan until flexible
Add cheese and optional filling to one half
fold over
Cook over medium heat, turning once, until tortilla is golden and cheese melts
repeat
Slice and serve hot.
recipes.sides: Serve with salsa and beans.
recipes.substitutions: Use flour tortillas or add cooked beans.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers and reheat in a dry pan.
recipes.safety: Use cooked fillings and heat until cheese melts fully.

recipes.name: Chicken and green chile tamales
recipes.description: Steamed masa parcels filled with chicken and tomatillo salsa.
instructions: Beat shortening until fluffy
mix masa harina, baking powder and salt
gradually beat in masa and stock until soft
Spread masa on each softened husk
add chicken and a spoon of salsa
fold sides and bottom
Stand tamales upright in a steamer over simmering water
cover and steam 50 to 60 minutes until masa separates from husk
rest 10 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve with extra salsa and beans.
recipes.substitutions: Fill with beans and cheese for a meat-free option.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked tamales up to 3 days; reheat by steaming.
recipes.safety: Keep filling chilled before assembly and cook tamales fully; beware steam.

recipes.name: Chicken enchiladas with green salsa
recipes.description: Corn tortillas filled with chicken, covered in tomatillo salsa and baked with cheese.
instructions: Warm tortillas in a dry pan until pliable
Warm salsa in a saucepan
Fill tortillas with chicken, roll and place seam down in a baking dish
Cover with remaining salsa and cheese
Bake at 190 C for 15 minutes until bubbling
finish with crema and onion.
recipes.sides: Serve with beans and rice.
recipes.substitutions: Use cooked black beans instead of chicken.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Use chicken cooked and stored safely; reheat enchiladas to steaming.

recipes.name: Chilaquiles in red salsa
recipes.description: Crisp tortilla pieces briefly simmered in salsa and finished with cheese and crema.
instructions: Dry tortilla pieces briefly, then fry in batches until crisp
drain
Warm salsa in a wide pan until simmering
Add tortilla chips and toss briefly so edges soften while centres stay crisp
Top with cheese, crema, onion and cilantro and serve immediately.
recipes.sides: Add fried eggs or shredded chicken for a fuller meal.
recipes.substitutions: Bake tortilla triangles at 200 C until crisp instead of frying.
recipes.storage: Best immediately; store salsa and chips separately.
recipes.safety: Cook optional eggs and chicken fully; handle hot oil carefully.

recipes.name: Chilli-marinated pork tacos
recipes.description: Thin pork cooked with achiote, guajillo chile and pineapple, served in small tortillas.
instructions: Soak seeded chiles in hot water
blend with achiote, orange juice, vinegar and spices
Coat pork and marinate covered in refrigerator at least 2 hours
Heat grill or pan very hot
cook pork in batches until browned and cooked through
Rest and chop
grill pineapple pieces
Serve in warm tortillas with pineapple, onion and cilantro.
recipes.sides: Serve with lime wedges and salsa.
recipes.substitutions: Use chicken thighs and cook thoroughly.
recipes.storage: Marinate refrigerated up to 12 hours; cooked pork lasts 3 days chilled.
recipes.safety: Do not reuse marinade unless boiled; cook pork through.

recipes.name: Chipotle shredded chicken tostadas
recipes.description: Shredded chicken simmered with tomato, onion and smoky chipotle.
instructions: Blend tomatoes with chipotle and a little adobo sauce
Cook onion in oil until soft
add tomato-chipotle puree and simmer 10 minutes
Stir in chicken and simmer until hot and saucy
Spoon onto tostadas and top with lettuce and crema.
recipes.sides: Serve with avocado and lime.
recipes.substitutions: Use fewer chipotles for a milder sauce.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate chicken mixture up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Reheat cooked chicken once until steaming hot.

recipes.name: Cinnamon corn atole
recipes.description: A warm thick drink made with masa, milk, cinnamon and piloncillo.
instructions: Whisk masa harina with 200 ml cold milk until smooth.
Warm remaining milk with cinnamon and sugar until dissolved.
Whisk in masa mixture and simmer gently, stirring, until thick and smooth; add vanilla and remove cinnamon.
recipes.sides: Serve hot with tamales or sweet bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use plant milk and brown sugar.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat while stirring.
recipes.safety: Keep hot drink away from children; stir before serving.

recipes.name: Citrus-grilled beef tacos
recipes.description: Thin beef marinated with citrus and grilled quickly over high heat.
instructions: Mix citrus, garlic, cumin and oil; coat beef and marinate covered in refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Heat grill or pan until very hot; cook steak 3 to 5 minutes per side depending on thickness and desired doneness.
Rest 5 minutes, slice thinly across grain and serve in warm tortillas with onion and cilantro.
recipes.sides: Serve with salsa and charred spring onions.
recipes.substitutions: Use skirt steak or chicken thighs.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked beef promptly and use within 3 days.
recipes.safety: Keep raw beef separate; use a thermometer for the preferred safe doneness.

recipes.name: Elote street corn
recipes.description: Grilled corn coated with lime, mayonnaise, chile and crumbly cheese.
instructions: Grill corn over medium heat, turning often, until kernels are lightly charred and tender.
Mix mayonnaise with lime zest and a little juice.
Brush corn with lime mayonnaise, roll in cheese and dust with chilli and salt.
recipes.sides: Serve hot with lime wedges.
recipes.substitutions: Use boiled corn and feta if cotija is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Serve immediately; refrigerate leftovers and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Use clean utensils for the mayonnaise and cheese.

recipes.name: Fresh tomato salsa
recipes.description: Chopped tomato, onion, cilantro, chile and lime for tacos and grilled food.
instructions: Dice tomatoes and onion evenly
remove chile seeds for less heat
Mix vegetables with cilantro and lime
season
Rest 10 minutes and drain excess liquid if desired.
recipes.sides: Serve with tortilla chips, tacos or beans.
recipes.substitutions: Use mild pepper or omit chile.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate covered and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Wash produce and keep salsa chilled.

recipes.name: Mexican bread pudding
recipes.description: Toasted bread layered with fruit, nuts and a piloncillo-spice syrup.
instructions: Toast bread slices until dry and golden
Simmer sugar, water, cinnamon and cloves until syrupy
Remove spices
Layer bread, raisins, peanuts and cheese in a baking dish
pour syrup evenly over top
Bake at 180 C for 25 minutes until set and edges crisp.
recipes.sides: Serve warm or at room temperature.
recipes.substitutions: Use brown sugar and almonds instead of piloncillo and peanuts.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours; use within 3 days and reheat thoroughly.
recipes.safety: Check peanut allergy; cool and store promptly.

recipes.name: Mexican red rice
recipes.description: Rice toasted with tomato, onion and garlic, then steamed until the grains are separate.
instructions: Blend tomatoes, onion and garlic until smooth
Rinse rice and drain
toast in oil over medium heat until lightly golden
Add tomato puree and stir 2 minutes
pour in stock and vegetables, cover and simmer low until rice is tender
rest covered 5 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve with beans, eggs or stewed meat.
recipes.substitutions: Use frozen mixed vegetables or omit them.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly and use within 2 days; reheat once.
recipes.safety: Cool rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour; reheat until steaming.

recipes.name: Molletes
recipes.description: Toasted bread rolls topped with refried beans and melted cheese.
instructions: Heat oven grill to medium and arrange rolls cut-side up.
Spread beans over each half and top with cheese.
Grill until cheese melts and bread edges toast; top with pico de gallo.
recipes.sides: Serve with salsa and sliced avocado.
recipes.substitutions: Use sourdough rolls or black beans.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; store bean topping refrigerated separately.
recipes.safety: Use cooked beans and keep toppings chilled until serving.

recipes.name: Oaxacan black bean tostadas
recipes.description: Large crisp tortillas spread with beans and topped with cabbage, avocado and cheese.
instructions: Warm beans in saucepan until spreadable
Toast tortillas on a hot dry griddle until crisp but still foldable
Spread beans over each tortilla
add cabbage, sliced tomato, avocado and cheese
Warm briefly on griddle until cheese softens
serve.
recipes.sides: Add grilled vegetables or cooked meat if desired.
recipes.substitutions: Use small tostadas if large tortillas are unavailable.
recipes.storage: Assemble just before eating; keep toppings chilled.
recipes.safety: Keep fresh toppings refrigerated and separate until serving.

recipes.name: Pickled red onions
recipes.description: Quick citrus-pickled onions served with cochinita pibil and tacos.
instructions: Place sliced onions in a heatproof bowl
Pour over boiling water for 10 seconds, then drain
Add citrus juices, oregano, salt and optional sliced habanero
toss
Rest at least 30 minutes, tossing once, until bright pink and softened.
recipes.sides: Serve with pork tacos, beans or grilled fish.
recipes.substitutions: Use cider vinegar and lime if sour oranges are unavailable.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate covered and use within 4 days.
recipes.safety: Wash onions and keep refrigerated.

recipes.name: Pot-cooked pinto beans
recipes.description: Slow-simmered beans with onion and herbs, a staple side that also fills tacos.
ingredients: 400 g dried pinto beans, picked over
instructions: Rinse beans and soak overnight if desired
drain
Put beans, onion, garlic, bay and fresh water in a heavy pot
bring to a boil
Lower to a gentle simmer, partly covered, until creamy and tender, 1.5 to 2 hours
add hot water as needed
Salt near the end and remove bay.
recipes.sides: Serve in bowls with broth, or mash for refried beans.
recipes.substitutions: Use black beans and adjust cooking time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 4 days; reheat until boiling hot.
recipes.safety: Soak refrigerated in warm conditions; boil beans thoroughly and never slow-cook raw kidney beans at low temperature.

recipes.name: Puebla chile and chocolate sauce
recipes.description: A layered sauce of toasted chiles, seeds, spices and chocolate served over chicken.
instructions: Toast chiles briefly in a dry pan
remove stems and seeds
soak in hot water 20 minutes
Toast sesame, almonds, tortilla, bread and spices separately until fragrant
Soften onion and tomatoes
blend with drained chiles, toasted ingredients and some stock until smooth
Fry puree in oil carefully
add stock and simmer 45 minutes, stirring
add chocolate to melt
spoon over hot chicken.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice and sesame seeds.
recipes.substitutions: Use fewer chiles for a milder sauce.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate sauce separately up to 4 days; freeze in portions.
recipes.safety: Keep sauce simmering gently and reheat until steaming; check nut allergies.

recipes.name: Ranch-style eggs on tortillas
recipes.description: Fried eggs served over warm corn tortillas with a cooked tomato-chile salsa.
instructions: Char tomatoes, onion and chile in a dry pan
chop or blend coarsely
Simmer salsa with a little oil for 8 minutes and season
Warm tortillas and spread with beans
Fry eggs until whites are set and yolks to desired doneness
place on tortillas and spoon over salsa.
recipes.sides: Serve with avocado and beans.
recipes.substitutions: Use mild jalapeno or omit chile.
recipes.storage: Serve immediately; keep ingredients separate if preparing ahead.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs to safe doneness for vulnerable diners.

recipes.name: Red hominy and pork soup
recipes.description: A celebratory hominy soup with tender pork in a mild red chile broth.
instructions: Simmer pork with half the onion and garlic in water until tender, about 2 hours
remove pork and shred
Soak seeded guajillo chiles in hot water
blend with remaining garlic and a ladle of broth, then strain
Add chile puree and hominy to broth
simmer 30 minutes
return pork and heat through
Serve with shredded cabbage, radish, lime and oregano.
recipes.sides: Serve with tostadas and lime.
recipes.substitutions: Use chicken and reduce simmering time.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat soup until boiling.
recipes.safety: Cook pork until tender and fully hot; keep garnishes separate and chilled.

recipes.name: Refried pinto beans
recipes.description: Cooked pinto beans mashed and fried with onion until creamy.
ingredients: 500 g cooked pinto beans with a little broth
instructions: Cook onion in oil over medium heat until soft.
Add beans and cumin; mash with a potato masher, adding broth until creamy.
Stir and fry gently 10 to 15 minutes until thick; season and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve with tortillas, eggs or rice.
recipes.substitutions: Use black beans or vegetable oil.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 4 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Reheat thoroughly and stir to heat evenly.

recipes.name: Squash with corn and tomato
recipes.description: Tender courgette, corn, tomato and onion cooked together as a simple seasonal side.
instructions: Cook onion in oil until soft.
Add tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes; stir in courgette and cover until nearly tender.
Add corn and cook 4 minutes more; season and finish with crumbled cheese.
recipes.sides: Serve with beans, rice or warm tortillas.
recipes.substitutions: Use pumpkin or green beans in season.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Keep cheese chilled until serving.

recipes.name: Stuffed poblano peppers
recipes.description: Roasted poblano peppers filled with cheese, dipped in egg batter and fried.
instructions: Char peppers under a grill, turning until blistered
cover 10 minutes, peel carefully and slit to remove seeds
Fill each pepper with cheese and secure opening with a toothpick
Dip in flour, then coat in whipped egg whites folded with yolks
shallow-fry, turning, until golden and egg is cooked
Simmer tomato, onion and garlic into a quick sauce and serve beneath peppers.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice and beans.
recipes.substitutions: Use roasted peppers without batter for a lighter version.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook egg coating fully and remove toothpicks before eating.

recipes.name: Sweet corn tamales
recipes.description: Soft masa parcels sweetened with cinnamon and raisins, steamed in corn husks.
instructions: Beat butter and sugar until fluffy
Mix masa harina, baking powder and cinnamon
beat into butter with warm milk until soft
Fold in raisins
spread masa on soaked husks, fold and tie
Steam upright over water for 50 to 60 minutes until masa releases from husk
rest briefly.
recipes.sides: Serve warm with hot chocolate.
recipes.substitutions: Use coconut milk and dairy-free spread.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat by steaming.
recipes.safety: Avoid burns from hot steamer; cook masa fully.

recipes.name: Thick masa cakes with beans
recipes.description: Pan-cooked masa cakes split and filled with beans, cheese or stew.
instructions: Mix masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough
rest covered 10 minutes
Divide into 8 balls, press into thick rounds
Cook on a hot dry griddle 3 to 4 minutes each side until puffed and cooked
Cool slightly, split along edge and fill with beans, cheese and toppings.
recipes.sides: Serve with salsa and shredded lettuce.
recipes.substitutions: Fill with cooked potato, chicken or mushrooms.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; keep cooked cakes covered and use same day.
recipes.safety: Keep perishable fillings chilled until serving.

recipes.name: Tostadas with tuna
recipes.description: Crisp corn tostadas topped with lime-seasoned tuna, avocado and cabbage.
instructions: Mix tuna with lime, onion, tomato and a pinch of salt.
Arrange cabbage over tostadas and spoon tuna mixture on top.
Add avocado slices and serve immediately.
recipes.sides: Serve with salsa and lime.
recipes.substitutions: Use cooked shredded chicken or mashed beans.
recipes.storage: Keep tuna mixture covered and refrigerated; use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Use shelf-stable tuna and refrigerate mixture promptly after opening.

recipes.name: Yucatan achiote pork
recipes.description: Slow-roasted pork marinated with achiote, citrus and warm spices.
instructions: Blend achiote, citrus, cumin, oregano, garlic and salt
coat pork and marinate refrigerated at least 4 hours
Line covered casserole with banana leaf if available
add pork and marinade
cover tightly
Bake at 160 C for about 3 hours until pork pulls apart
shred in cooking juices.
recipes.sides: Serve in warm tortillas with pickled red onion.
recipes.substitutions: Use foil instead of banana leaf.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Marinate pork in the refrigerator and cook until tender and hot throughout.

recipes.name: Yucatan lime soup
recipes.description: Chicken broth with tomato, aromatic herbs and bright lime, served with crisp tortilla strips.
instructions: Simmer chicken in stock until cooked
remove and shred
Fry tortilla strips in a little oil until crisp
drain
Cook onion, tomato and garlic in pot until soft
add broth and oregano, simmer 15 minutes
Return chicken
add lime juice just before serving
garnish with tortilla strips.
recipes.sides: Serve with extra lime and cilantro.
recipes.substitutions: Use cooked turkey or vegetable broth with beans.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate soup up to 2 days; store tortilla strips separately.
recipes.safety: Cook chicken fully; refrigerate broth promptly.
